text:
Your biggest enemy isn't laziness. It's your circle.

You know what separates builders from broke people? Not work ethic. Who they spend time with.

Edison didn't succeed because he worked harder. He succeeded because Firestone, Ford, Burroughs pushed his thinking higher.

You can't rise above your circle. Your circle sets the gravity.

Here's the move: Audit your five closest people. Would you want to become them in ten years? If no, find builders instead.

Bad circle, hard ceiling. Good circle, fast ceiling.
caption:
The most important success habit isn't time management. It's choosing the right men to spend time with.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
